requirements.requirement: Identify La Bulle Bleue as an APAiL initiative in Chalon-sur-Saône.
requirements.acceptance: Page and metadata state initiative, association and city.

requirements.requirement: Describe audience without inventing eligibility.
requirements.acceptance: Children from age 6, teenagers and adults; no diagnosis-based criteria.

requirements.requirement: Describe sourced activity examples without promising fixed programme.
requirements.acceptance: Games, creative activity, gardening/outings and discussion represented.

requirements.requirement: Provide primary email contact route.
requirements.acceptance: Visible mailto links use apail@live.fr.

requirements.requirement: Do not publish unresolved address or stale weekly hours.
requirements.acceptance: No street address or fixed hours; confirm them directly by email.

requirements.requirement: Responsive, keyboard-operable navigation.
requirements.acceptance: Menu opens; Escape closes only while expanded and then restores focus to its trigger; Escape while closed is inert; selecting a link closes the menu; outside click closes the menu without forced focus.
requirements.validation: Chromium in-memory runtime interaction (Loop 001) + Node.js interaction regression test (Loop 002)

requirements.requirement: Prevent horizontal overflow at supported viewports.
requirements.acceptance: No horizontal overflow at 320–1920 px test matrix.

requirements.requirement: Provide baseline French SEO metadata.
requirements.acceptance: lang, title, meta description, OG data, JSON-LD and robots.txt.

requirements.requirement: Implement accessibility foundations.
requirements.acceptance: Main landmark, one h1, labeled nav, skip link, focus styles, Escape and reduced motion.
requirements.validation: Semantic/keyboard checks; screen-reader assessment not run

requirements.requirement: Avoid paid or unnecessary third-party runtime dependencies.
requirements.acceptance: No framework packages, remote fonts, tracking, analytics or embeds.

requirements.requirement: Validate hosting, headers and deployed routes.
requirements.acceptance: Configured host and production URL observed.

requirements.requirement: Validate multiple browser engines and assistive technologies.
requirements.acceptance: Firefox, WebKit and screen-reader environments executed.

requirements.requirement: Escape must not steal focus when the mobile navigation is already closed.
requirements.acceptance: Dispatching Escape in closed state does not focus the menu toggle; when open, Escape closes and returns focus once.

requirements.requirement: Explain the relationship and distinct roles of La Bulle Bleue and APAiL.
requirements.acceptance: Page identifies La Bulle Bleue as a local initiative launched in 2021 and APAiL as parent association created in 1995.

requirements.requirement: Show a broader selection of publicly reported activity examples.
requirements.acceptance: Games, garden/outdoors, discovery/workshops and culture/music/outings are represented; dated stories are explicitly non-recurring examples.

requirements.requirement: Improve visual richness with an image-led hero, activity imagery, stories and APAiL mission illustration.
requirements.acceptance: Hero illustration, four activity cards, dated story mosaic and parent-association visual are present.
requirements.validation: HTML image inventory and visual structure inspection

requirements.requirement: Avoid unlicensed identifiable participant or press photographs.
requirements.acceptance: Only original locally authored non-identifying SVG illustrations are used; illustrations are labelled as such.
requirements.validation: Image source inventory and HTML asset path review

requirements.requirement: Provide optimized and accessible local visual assets.
requirements.acceptance: Informative images use local paths, useful alt text, width/height and lazy loading below fold; hero uses fetchpriority high.

requirements.requirement: Add restrained motion with reduced-motion support.
requirements.acceptance: IntersectionObserver reveals only when supported and reduced motion is not requested; essential content stays visible by default.
requirements.validation: Source review and Node interaction test; browser animation observation pending

requirements.requirement: Keep activity/story visuals accessible and non-interactive without gallery controls.
requirements.acceptance: Images are static content with alt text; no inert click affordances, focus trap or custom lightbox.

requirements.requirement: Protect performance and privacy while adding assets.
requirements.acceptance: No third-party image hosts; local SVGs; lazy loading and explicit dimensions for below-fold images.

requirements.requirement: Preserve factual content provenance and avoid unsupported outcomes.
requirements.acceptance: Dated stories identify public-report context; international mission attributed to 2025 coverage; no names, diagnoses or medical outcomes.
requirements.status: PASS WITH MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE SOCIAL FEED LIMIT
